meta.seo_title: Physiotherapy Meta Ads Case Study | PPC Guru
meta.meta_description: How PPC Guru launched a physiotherapy clinic's Meta Ads and grew to 50 lead-form enquiries a month at under $10 each, with cost per lead down 36% in the first full month.

headline: How a Physiotherapy Clinic Launched Meta Ads at Under $10 a Lead
summary_line: PPC Guru launched a Meta Ads lead program for True Life Wellness Physio and improved it fast: in the first two months the clinic went from 32 lead-form enquiries in June 2026 to 50 in July 2026, while cost per lead fell 36% to under $10 — all on a steady budget of about $500 a month.
client_context: True Life Wellness Physio is a physiotherapy and wellness clinic serving patients in Ontario, Canada. The practice provides hands-on physiotherapy, injury rehabilitation and related wellness treatments, and depends on a steady flow of new-patient enquiries to fill its schedule. Alongside its search advertising, the clinic added Meta Ads to reach people on Facebook and Instagram and capture new-patient enquiries directly through lead forms.
background: The clinic partnered with PPC Guru to open a new lead channel on Meta. This was a fresh launch rather than a takeover: PPC Guru built a single focused Instant Form lead campaign, set up the form and tracking, and began optimizing from the first weeks of delivery. The program's first full month was June 2026.
analysis: With a modest starting budget, the plan was to prove the channel before scaling it. A single Instant Form campaign kept spend concentrated and learning fast, so PPC Guru could optimize audiences and creative against a clear signal — genuine form submissions — and drive cost per lead down before adding budget.
analysis_points: Launch one focused Instant Form lead campaign to capture new-patient enquiries in-platform.
Optimize toward genuine form submissions, not clicks or reach.
Refine audience and creative weekly on a controlled budget before scaling.
Track cost per lead month over month as the core success metric.

timeline.what: Meta Ads launch — first full month delivered 32 lead-form enquiries at about $15.62 each.
50 lead-form enquiries at $9.95 each — leads up 56% and cost per lead down 36% on a steady budget.

challenge: As a new Meta Ads program on a modest budget, the account had to prove that Facebook and Instagram could produce genuine new-patient enquiries at a sustainable cost before any scaling. The goal for the first two months was simple: grow lead volume while bringing cost per lead down.

changes.why: Captured patient enquiries directly in-platform and concentrated a modest budget so the account learned quickly.
Told Meta to find people who actually submit an enquiry, not just click, so spend chased genuine leads.
Tightened targeting and messaging month one to month two, driving cost per lead down 36%.

changes.change: Steady budget while proving the channel
changes.why: Held spend near $500 a month so month-over-month gains reflected efficiency, not extra budget.

benchmark: This is an early-stage launch: results cover the first two complete months only. The trend is strong — more leads at a lower cost on the same budget — but a longer run of data is needed before it can be read as a settled, quarter-over-quarter average.
gradual: In just its second month, the account did what a healthy launch should: more genuine enquiries at a lower cost, without spending more. Lead-form enquiries rose from 32 to 50 while cost per lead fell from $15.62 to $9.95 and click-through rate ticked up from 2.87% to 3.03%. The chart below shows the first two months of the program.
lessons: Start a new Meta channel with one focused lead campaign so the account learns fast on a modest budget.
Optimize toward genuine form submissions, not clicks, so spend chases real enquiries.
Prove cost per lead before scaling — a lower cost per lead on a steady budget is the signal to invest more.
Refine audience and creative every week in the early going; small changes move cost per lead quickly.
Judge a launch on its trend, and give it a longer run before drawing firm conclusions.
why_it_worked: A single focused campaign concentrated a modest budget and sped up learning.
Optimizing to form submissions kept the account chasing genuine enquiries.
Weekly creative and audience refinement drove cost per lead down 36% in one month.
Holding budget steady meant the gains came from efficiency, not extra spend.
outcome: Two months into its Meta Ads program, True Life Wellness Physio has an early but encouraging lead channel. In July 2026 it generated 50 lead-form enquiries at $9.95 each — up from 32 at $15.62 in the launch month — on a steady budget of about $500. The direction is exactly what a healthy launch should show: more genuine enquiries at a lower cost. With efficiency proven, the account is well positioned to scale budget carefully in the months ahead.
cta: PPC Guru helps Canadian clinics open new patient-enquiry channels with focused, conversion-first Meta Ads and transparent reporting.
methodology: All figures are pulled directly from the client's Meta Ads account and shown on a monthly basis. 'Leads' are Instant Form submissions counted by Meta's lead metric. This is a launch story covering the first two complete months (June and July 2026); confidence is marked Low because no full quarter of data exists yet.
lead_quality: Leads are patient-submitted Instant Forms, so the clinic receives contact details to follow up on genuine new-patient enquiries.
teaser: 📈 Physiotherapy Meta Ads case study: PPC Guru launched True Life Wellness Physio on Facebook & Instagram and, in month two, grew to 50 lead-form enquiries at under $10 each — cost per lead down 36% on a steady budget.
